name: portafolio-francisco
description: Portafolio profesional de Francisco - React + Express sobre AWS Elastic Beanstalk

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @portafolio/server" "npm run dev -w @portafolio/client"
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
